SELECT TRIM(COALESCE(tb.train_no, ts.train_no)) AS trainNo, TRIM(CASE COALESCE(tb.train_type, '99') WHEN '0' THEN '高铁' WHEN '1' THEN '动车' WHEN '2' THEN '普快' ELSE '其他' END) AS trainType, TRIM(ts.start_station) AS startStation, TRIM(ts.end_station) AS endStation, DATE_FORMAT(ts.depart_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS departDate, COALESCE((SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tss.depart_time, '%H:%i:%s') FROM train_schedule_station tss WHERE tss.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id AND tss.station_order = 1), '') AS startTime, COALESCE((SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tss.arrive_time, '%H:%i:%s') FROM train_schedule_station tss WHERE tss.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id AND tss.station_order = (SELECT MAX(station_order) FROM train_schedule_station WHERE schedule_id = ts.schedule_id)), '') AS arriveTime, TRIM(COALESCE(ts.total_duration, '')) AS totalDuration, -- 新增：查询该车次的总里程（终点站的累计里程） (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cumulative_mileage), 0) FROM train_schedule_station WHERE schedule_id = ts.schedule_id) AS totalMileage FROM train_schedule ts LEFT JOIN train_basic tb ON ts.train_no = tb.train_no WHERE ts.status = '0'
AND TRIM(ts.start_station) = TRIM(#{startStation})
AND TRIM(ts.end_station) = TRIM(#{endStation})
AND DATE_FORMAT(ts.depart_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = TRIM(#{departDate})
ORDER BY ts.depart_date ASC, startTime ASC

-- 先查询该车次的总里程 SELECT TRIM(CASE tc.carriage_type WHEN '0' THEN '二等座' WHEN '1' THEN '一等座' WHEN '2' THEN '商务座' WHEN '3' THEN '硬卧' WHEN '4' THEN '软卧' ELSE '' END) AS seatType, SUM(IFNULL(tc.available_seats, 0)) AS remainSeats, -- 核心：按座位类型计算票价 CASE tc.carriage_type WHEN '0' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cumulative_mileage), 0) FROM train_schedule_station WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}) * 1.0 -- 二等座1元/公里 WHEN '1' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cumulative_mileage), 0) FROM train_schedule_station WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}) * 1.5 -- 一等座1.5元/公里 ELSE 0.0 -- 其他座位类型默认0 END AS price FROM train_carriage tc WHERE tc.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} GROUP BY tc.carriage_type

SELECT station_order AS stationOrder, TRIM(station_name) AS stationName, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(arrive_time, '%H:%i:%s'), '') AS arriveTime, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(depart_time, '%H:%i:%s'), '') AS departTime, TRIM(COALESCE(stop_duration, '')) AS stopDuration, COALESCE(cumulative_mileage, 0) AS mileage FROM train_schedule_station WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY station_order ASC
SELECT schedule_id FROM train_schedule WHERE TRIM(train_no) = TRIM(#{trainNo}) AND DATE_FORMAT(depart_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = TRIM(#{departDate}) LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(station_name) FROM train_schedule_station UNION SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(start_station) FROM train_schedule UNION SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(end_station) FROM train_schedule ORDER BY 1 ASC
